---
title: Write a pack
description: A skill with its scripts, templates and tests. Use meeting-intake as the reference.
---

<Status state="available">The meeting-intake pack is the working reference: <code>packs/meeting-intake/</code>.</Status>

```
packs/meeting-intake/
├── SKILL.md          instructions for the agent: when to use it, what to produce
├── pack.yaml         version, capabilities it needs, what it reads and writes
├── workflows/        the workflow that runs it
├── scripts/          deterministic code: JSON in, JSON out
├── schemas/          the data contract between the agent and the scripts
├── templates/        output templates, e.g. minutes
└── tests/            fixtures and tests
```

## Rules

1. **Scripts never call APIs.** They receive data from connectors and return JSON, so the same script
   works whichever tool provided the data.
2. **Packs need capabilities, not connectors.** `issues.read` can come from ACC or BCF.
3. **Agents reason, scripts decide.** In meeting-intake, the agent extracts and classifies meeting items;
   a script decides where each goes and turns every uncertainty into a question.
4. **Every pack ships tests** and at least one evaluation scenario, and a documentation page.
